hero.intro: Creator product intern at Qwen and a social anthropology master’s student at LSE. My work focuses on AI agents, evaluation, and tools for creators.

education.school: London School of Economics and Political Science
education.courses: **Coursework:** Psychological Anthropology (Distinction), Anthropology of Religion (Distinction), Digital Anthropology, Gender and Kinship, Anthropological Research Methods.
**Coursework:** Global Communication, Data Visualization, Introduction to Statistics, Digital Media Marketing Strategy, Journalism Ethics and Media Regulation, Cross-cultural Multimedia News Editing.

experience.intro: Built creator-product capabilities across AI Agents, evaluation, and overseas product exploration.

projects.title: Qwen Create [[Agent Teams|A group of coordinated Agents that work together across steps in a video-creation task.]]
projects.subtitle: A [[multi-agent system|A system where multiple specialized AI agents coordinate to complete a larger task.]] for end-to-end video creation
projects.intro: Built Skill creation and evaluation capabilities, with Runtime improvements for reusable video workflows.

bullets.label: [[Skill|A reusable instruction set that helps an Agent perform a task consistently.]] creation [[Agent|An AI system that can work toward a goal and use tools to complete task steps.]]
bullets.body: Helped launch an [[Agent|An AI system that can work toward a goal and use tools to complete task steps.]] that turns canvas workflows into editable [[Skill|A reusable instruction set that helps an Agent perform a task consistently.]] drafts and uses [[multimodal understanding|Interpreting more than one type of input, such as video imagery and text.]] to break down creative works. Helped build a supply of [[100+ quality Skills|The creation Agent helped build a supply of more than 100 reusable Skills.]].

bullets.label: [[Skill|A reusable instruction set that helps an Agent perform a task consistently.]] evaluation system
bullets.body: Built layered test sets, evaluation criteria, and an automated platform with [[Skill-specific instructions|Test instructions tailored to each Skill’s capabilities and use cases.]] and [[controlled comparisons|Comparisons that hold model and tool conditions steady to isolate the effect of Skill use or version.]]. Launched internally, covering [[100+ Skills|The internal evaluation platform covers more than 100 Skills and their different versions.]] and their versions.

bullets.label: [[Runtime|The execution layer that manages an Agent’s context, tools, and task flow.]] optimization & model adaptation
bullets.body: Designed a [[Subagent|A helper agent assigned a focused task, such as extracting useful context from conversation history.]] to compress conversation history, reducing long-task token usage by [[5%|Reduction in total token usage on long tasks after the context optimization.]]. Updated [[Skill|A reusable instruction set that helps an Agent perform a task consistently.]] interfaces and [[model routing|Directing a generation request to the selected model through the right interface.]] for compatibility with [[Wan 3.0|A newly connected generation model; existing Skills were adapted to use it.]] and [[Qwen Image 3.0|A newly connected image generation model; existing Skills were adapted to use it.]].

stages: A generic prompt cannot tell whether a Skill works in the situations it was designed for.
Write instructions around each Skill’s capability and use case, then hold model and tool conditions constant.
An internal evaluation system now covers 100+ Skills and their versions, making iteration traceable.

projects.title: Qwen Create: overseas product exploration
projects.subtitle: [[North American demand validation|Research into whether North American users have relevant needs and whether the product can meet them.]] & growth-feature planning
projects.intro: Explored market entry, acquisition features, and website planning for overseas growth.

bullets.label: Market selection & entry strategy
bullets.body: Evaluated [[organic traffic|Visits that come from unpaid search results rather than advertisements.]], [[willingness and ability to pay|Whether potential customers both want the product enough to pay and have the capacity to do so.]], and [[acquisition costs|The cost of attracting a new user or customer.]] to select North America as the initial market.

bullets.label: Overseas marketing evaluation
bullets.body: Participated in [[Agent|An AI system that can work toward a goal and use tools to complete task steps.]] evaluation for North American and Latin American marketing scenarios. Authored the report on intent understanding, scripts, visuals, and editing, identifying strengths and improvement areas.

bullets.label: Search demand & [[SEO|Search engine optimization: shaping pages and content so people can find them through relevant searches.]] analysis
bullets.body: Prioritized background removal and AI face swap using search demand and conversion potential. Identified features better suited to display ads than search; worked with growth teams as overseas users grew by [[50%|Reported growth in overseas users during this period.]].

bullets.label: Website [[MVP|Minimum viable product: an early version focused on validating core product value.]] design
bullets.body: Mapped [[search intent|What someone is trying to find or accomplish with a search query.]] to product capabilities. Planned feature and scenario pages with examples, input requirements, and clear entry points.

stages: Overseas growth cannot begin with available features alone: the product needs both a credible use case and demand.
Evaluate North American and Latin American marketing scenarios, then pair product feasibility with search and conversion signals.
The work prioritized background removal and AI face swap, while separating search-led opportunities from display-ad creative.

experience.role: Creator Product Intern · Commercial Product Strategy
experience.intro: Improved creator discovery, brand collaboration, and creator monetization.

bullets.label: Creator search & matching
bullets.body: Contributed to [[periodic and time-sensitive creator labels|Tags that surface creators for seasonal topics, scheduled events, or interests that change over time.]] and cross-category [[semantic matching|Matching creators and opportunities by meaning and relevance, beyond exact keyword overlap.]] improvements. [[A/B tests|A controlled comparison between a version shown to one group and an alternative shown to another.]] showed [[21%|Search-result click-through rate in the experiment group; the control group was 18%.]] search [[CTR|Click-through rate: the share of people who see a result and click it.]] versus [[18%|The control group’s search-result click-through rate in the A/B test.]] in the control; [[post-search order conversion|The share of users who place an order after using creator search.]] rose from [[4.0%|Search-to-order conversion rate before the change.]] to [[4.4%|Search-to-order conversion rate after the change.]].

bullets.label: Platform feature improvements
bullets.body: Helped turn client requirements into pricing, collaboration, scheduling, and invitation features after validating rule boundaries and risks. Supported requests worth over [[RMB 3 million|The total value of client requests supported by the product changes.]]; collaborating creators grew by [[135%|Growth in the number of creators collaborating with brands after the feature changes.]].

bullets.label: Creator opportunity matching
bullets.body: Organized 618 Spark Gala and home-renovation creator recruitment. Orders grew [[25%|Month-over-month increase in brand collaboration orders during the campaign period.]] month over month; recommended creators made up [[2%|Share of the overall creator pool represented by the event’s recommended creators.]] of the pool and [[11%|Share of order value contributed by the event’s recommended creators.]] of [[order value|The monetary value of orders attributed to the recommended creators.]]. Helped [[400+|More than 400 creators received their first brand deal through these activities.]] creators land their first brand deal.

experience.intro: Supported Changi Airport and Pepsi through digital proposals and creator campaigns.

bullets.label: Digital product design
bullets.body: Designed digital features for Changi Airport’s China proposal. Used mobile-platform habits and shopping behavior to propose platform-based touchpoints in place of website-led traffic; adopted in the final proposal.

bullets.label: Creator campaigns
bullets.body: Completed [[130+|More than 130 creator assessments were completed in one month.]] creator assessments, [[65+|More than 65 scripts were reviewed in one month.]] script reviews, and 50 collaborations in one month for Pepsi. Refined screening and collaboration processes, improving script approval by [[30%|Increase in script approval rate after improving the collaboration process.]].

creatorAssistant.title: Creator content diagnosis & topic co-creation assistant
creatorAssistant.label: Personal project · Vibe Coding
creatorAssistant.body: Built a multi-agent assistant that uses account history and reader feedback to help smaller creators find repeatable topics and content structures. Applied to [[50+ posts|More than 50 posts were used to apply the content assistant.]], with [[average readership increasing by approximately 18%|Approximate increase in average readership across posts using the assistant.]].

stages: Some creators have successful posts but no reliable way to turn those signals into the next strong idea.
Use account history and reader feedback, then let multiple Agents simulate audience reactions and discuss candidate content.
Applied across 50+ posts, the assistant helped raise average readership by approximately 18%.

sheepGuide.title: Qwen · Agent Teams
notes: This project connects reusable creative Skills with a way to evaluate how well they work.
Each Skill gets relevant test instructions. Model and tool conditions stay fixed within each comparison, so changes in output can be investigated.
The internal platform covers 100+ Skills and their versions. The work also includes context compression and adapting existing Skills to new models.

sheepGuide.title: Qwen · Overseas exploration
notes: Here, product evaluation meets market research: what can the Agent do well, and where is there demand?
Qishan participated in overseas marketing evaluations and wrote the report on intent, scripts, visuals and editing.
Search-demand research helped prioritize background removal and face swap. Website work here concerns planning feature and scenario pages.

sheepGuide.title: Xiaohongshu · Creator products
notes: This work helps brands find suitable creators and makes collaboration easier.
Creator labels and semantic matching broadened discovery. The search experiment showed 21% click-through versus 18% in the control.
The work also covered collaboration features and creator activities, helping 400+ creators receive their first brand deal.

sheepGuide.title: Publicis · Client campaigns
notes: This is where understanding audience habits turns into practical campaign decisions.
For Changi Airport, mobile-platform and shopping behavior informed a proposal for platform-based digital touchpoints.
For Pepsi, creator assessments, script reviews and collaboration-process improvements helped raise script approval rates.

sheepGuide.title: Personal · Creator assistant
notes: This personal project grew from a creator’s own question: how do you turn a few successful posts into a repeatable approach?
Account history and reader feedback inform diagnosis and topic ideas. Multiple agents simulate different audience perspectives and summarize feedback.
The assistant was applied to 50+ posts, with average readership increasing by approximately 18%.
